page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.c1 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data.

This instance features dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring that compute resources are not shared with other tenants. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions the server as a compute-focused resource. Because there is no bundled local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, the cost profile is centered purely on dedicated compute and memory allocation, allowing for predictable resource availability without the overhead of unused local disk capacity.

Given the 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.c1.large is suited for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. Appropriate use cases include web serving, batch processing, application servers, and distributed microservices that rely on network-attached storage.
